title: Time and Killed Resolvents in Reflected Optimal Stopping with a Max Payoff
summary: We study infinite-horizon optimal stopping for normally reflected two-dimensional diffusions in the positive quadrant with max payoff \(G(x_1,x_2)=x_1\veeαx_2\). The non-smooth payoff produces a singular stopping-gain measure on the kink set \(Δ=\{x_1=αx_2\}\). We prove $\displaystyle Γ^Δ(dx) = -\frac{n^\top a(x)n}{2\sqrt{1+α^2}}\,σ_Δ(dx)$, with $n=(1,-α)$, so the diagonal component is non-positive and strictly negative under local ellipticity.
